rationale: Price has traveled to within $0.05 of the original target ($4.85) and the last three candles show a clear deceleration — volume dropping from 172K to 89K with the close drifting back up to $4.90 on each bar, indicating selling pressure is exhausting near the session low. The risk/reward of holding has deteriorated significantly since we are already at ~83% of the projected move, and a sustained bid at $4.87–$4.91 with lower volume suggests the path of least resistance is shifting; locking in the gain here is preferable to risking a snapback toward $5.00.
